admission.justification: Spans mcp/pyproject.toml and mcp/uv.lock, is proven by test_installed_mcp_meets_declared_floor_and_server_lists_tools, and prevents PyPI installs from selecting an mcp release below 1.17.0 (missing FastMCP.remove_tool and crashing server startup) or below 1.30.0 (re-exposing known 1.29.1 advisories).

applicability: The installable agents-remember-mcp package's mcp dependency specifier, its resolved Python lockfile, and the FastMCP server startup path.
conditions: mcp/pyproject.toml declares a single mcp dependency with a >=1.30.0 floor and <2 ceiling.
The installed mcp release satisfies the declared specifier and exposes FastMCP.remove_tool.
exclusions: A later migration to mcp 2.x that replaces the FastMCP 1.x API.
Other dependency version ranges declared in mcp/pyproject.toml.
statement: The mcp dependency in mcp/pyproject.toml requires at least 1.30.0 and below 2, mcp/uv.lock resolves an admissible 1.x release, and the installed distribution exposes FastMCP.remove_tool so unbound and role-bound servers list their tools.
title: Declared mcp floor stays at least 1.30.0 and below 2
